The cloud-worker wording and the cloud concurrency limit were dropped; the todolist became a visible checklist; the configured swarm-workers model with its inherit-parent default became task categories (task:qa, task:recon, task:coding) or exact race-arm models per fan-out section 3; the parallel tasks array, agent: poteto-agent and the role field became N independent bare subagent calls in one turn citing ../poteto-mode/references/fan-out.md, with one json subagent example; cloud_base_branch became the worktree base for writers (edit classes 2-3). Cursor's ISSUES sentence is restored on the reports line and in the worker task template: a worker that can prove a defect reports ISSUES and lists every issue it can prove, not only the first. The task template keeps ISSUES in plain text. Each brief and the worker task template list the claims to verify (a Claims slot) before any result, and a listed claim with no result counts as inconclusive. The Verifier prompt's per-claim pass, fail or inconclusive maps onto one overall status, in the same order in the prose and the template: a proved fail always means ISSUES, even when other checks could not run, and inconclusive claims stay inconclusive; otherwise PASS requires at least one listed claim and a pass for every listed claim; otherwise BLOCKED with the reason stated (zero listed claims, an inconclusive claim, or no check could run). The parent writes the claims, and together they cover the slice's share of the Phase A done predicate, so one trivial claim cannot stand for the slice. Aggregation recomputes each result's status (a coverage slice or a race arm) from its per-claim results in the same order, against the claims listed in its brief, where any proved fail, or any other defect the worker proves, means ISSUES, and uses the recomputed status whenever it differs from the reported PASS, ISSUES or BLOCKED; it never changes a status on judgment alone. Aggregation treats a PASS with no listed claims, or with no result for a claim listed in its brief, as BLOCKED. A first-pass race selects only an overall PASS. In coverage mode a BLOCKED slice is unverified and is reported with its reason next to the gaps, never as covered, and an ISSUES slice carries its inconclusive claims into the gaps. Rank-all and best-of ranking of ISSUES and BLOCKED is left unspecified, as upstream leaves it.
